headlines.title_en: US pending home sales fall to lowest level since early this year
headlines.summary_en: US pending home sales for July fell to the lowest level since the start of the year, reflecting a housing market weighed down by elevated mortgage rates and prices. Data from the National Association of Realtors (NAR) showed the contract signing index dropped 2.3% to 71.2, the lowest since January and matching the second-worst reading since data began in 2001; economists had expected no change. Demand declined across all four major US regions in the month. In the South, the largest home-selling region, the pending sales index fell 2.2% to the lowest level since January 2025. Pending sales in the West dropped 4.7%.

headlines.title: 我国已将建筑门窗等72种产品纳入绿色建材认证范畴
headlines.summary: 记者今天了解到，市场监管总局联合住房城乡建设部、工业和信息化部，逐步将建筑门窗、预拌混凝土、石材等6大类72种产品纳入绿色建材认证范畴，实施覆盖原材料开采、生产制造、使用流通至回收处置的全生命周期质量管控，从源头筑牢建材质量安全防线，提升产品绿色低碳属性。截至2026年6月底，全国绿色建材认证获证企业达5725家，有效证书11094张，带动全国绿色建材营收近1300亿元、比上年同期增长超过10%，预计2026年底全国绿色建材营收规模突破3000亿元，产业发展质效稳步提升。（央视）

headlines.title_en: China has included 72 products, including building doors and windows, in the green building materials certification scope
headlines.summary_en: Reporters learned today that the State Administration for Market Regulation, together with the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, has gradually included 72 products in 6 categories, such as building doors and windows, ready-mixed concrete, and stone, in the green building materials certification scope, implementing full life-cycle quality control covering raw material extraction, production and manufacturing, use and circulation, to recycling and disposal, building a solid quality and safety line for building materials from the source and enhancing the green, low-carbon attributes of products. As of the end of June 2026, 5,725 enterprises nationwide held green building materials certification, with 11,094 valid certificates, driving national green building materials revenue to nearly 130 billion yuan, up more than 10% year-on-year. It is expected that by the end of 2026, national green building materials revenue will exceed 300 billion yuan, with steady improvement in industry development quality and efficiency. (CCTV)

headlines.title_en: Two-year German bond yields rise 5 basis points; medium- and long-term German bond yields hit highest since 2011
headlines.summary_en: Tuesday (Aug 18) European afternoon, Germany's 10-year bond yield rose 3.8 basis points, rising for a third consecutive session (accumulating 12.8 basis points over the period), at 3.259%, trading higher all day; at 14:29 Beijing time it 'opened high' at 3.240%, holding near 3.255% for most of the session, reaching 3.272% at the 21:30 US stock market open, approaching the May 5, 2011 peak of 3.333%, the April 11, 2011 peak of 3.505%, the September 22, 2008 peak of 4.283%, and the July 23, 2008 peak of 4.699%. The 2-year German bond yield rose 5.0 basis points to 2.853%, trading in a 2.817%-2.861% range intraday; the 30-year German bond yield rose 2.4 basis points, up 13 basis points over the past three days.

headlines.title_en: Sovereign bond yields in France, Italy, Spain, and Greece broadly rise about 5 basis points
headlines.summary_en: Tuesday (Aug 18) European afternoon, France's 10-year bond yield rose 4.8 basis points, rising for a third consecutive session, at 4.114%, trading higher all day, reaching 4.128% at the 21:30 Beijing time US stock market open, approaching the November 6, 2008 peak of 4.203% and the September 22, 2008 peak of 4.548%. The 2-year French bond yield rose 4.7 basis points; the 30-year French bond yield rose 2.9 basis points. Italy's 10-year bond yield rose 5.8 basis points to 4.073%. Spain's 10-year bond yield rose 4.6 basis points to 3.707%. Greece's 10-year bond yield rose 5.7 basis points to 3.959%.

headlines.title: 美国7月新屋开工全面下滑 单户型住宅开工降至2022年以来最低
headlines.summary: 美国7月新屋开工活动下降，其中单户型住宅开工降至2022年以来最低。美国政府周二公布的数据显示，7月新屋开工数下降12.4%，折合年率为124万套，低于预期值135万套。单户型住宅开工下降9.9%，折合年率为80.8万套，为2022年11月以来最低。多户型住宅开工下降近17%，在前一个月大幅增长后回落。新屋开工下降显示美国房地产市场增长依然乏力。自伊朗冲突开始以来，抵押贷款利率上升，加之房价仍处高位，持续抑制住房需求。

headlines.title_en: US July new home starts decline across the board, with single-family starts falling to lowest since 2022
headlines.summary_en: US housing starts declined in July, with single-family starts falling to the lowest since 2022. Data released by the US government on Tuesday showed housing starts fell 12.4% to an annualized rate of 1.24 million units, below the 1.35 million expected. Single-family starts fell 9.9% to an annualized rate of 808,000, the lowest since November 2022. Multifamily starts fell nearly 17%, pulling back after a sharp gain the prior month. The decline in housing starts shows the US housing market remains weak. Since the start of the Iran conflict, rising mortgage rates and still-high home prices have continued to dampen housing demand.

headlines.summary: 美国7月二手住宅成屋签约销售量降至年初以来最低水平，反映出房地产市场深受高企抵押贷款利率和房价的困扰。 美国全国地产经纪商协会（NAR）数据显示，合同签约指数下降2.3%至71.2，为1月以来最低，并追平2001年有数据以来的第二差读数，受访经济学家原本预计会持平。美国四大地区当月需求均出现下滑。作为全美最大房屋销售区域的南部地区，待完成销售指数下降2.2%，降至2025年1月以来的最低水平。西部地区待完成销售下降4.7%。
